SELECT fb.id, fb.shipment_no AS shipmentNo, fb.shop_id AS shopId, s.shop_name AS shopName, fb.marketplace, fb.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.wh_name AS warehouseName, fb.platform_shipment_id AS platformShipmentId, fb.status, fb.shipped_at AS shippedAt, fb.received_at AS receivedAt, fb.remark, fb.created_by AS createdBy, fb.created_at AS createdAt, fb.updated_at AS updatedAt, NULL AS planItems, NULL AS boxes, NULL AS diffs FROM fba_shipment fb LEFT JOIN shop s ON fb.shop_id = s.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON fb.warehouse_id = w.id
AND fb.shipment_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.shipmentNo}, '%')
AND fb.status = #{query.status} AND fb.shop_id = #{query.shopId} AND fb.marketplace = #{query.marketplace} AND fb.warehouse_id = #{query.warehouseId}
ORDER BY fb.id DESC
